A density plot displays the distribution of a variable. Below are four density plots that have been randomly generated. Three of these have been randomly sourced from a single distribution, and one comes from a mixture of two distributions. Which one do you think is the one from the data set with two distributions?

truefeedback.text:
This is part of what looking for natural variability may look like. When you have big data, it may look natural. Here, the variable from two distributions is A, the data set with 10000 data points. Almost certainly, the distribution that looks the most normal is from a mixture of distributions. This is because we have a small number of points when generating the normal distribution.

A variable that looks normally distributed can be from a mixture of distributions. It may have a lot of data points so be flattened out. Looking for variability can help build your skillset as a data scientist. Variability is natural, and this topic looks at natural variability. We suggest you look at the set of slides on "Identifying Natural Variability".
